comparison.objective: Set and lock a gripper stop versus insert a cotter pin and permanently bend both legs to secure a clevis.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses reversible coupled-thread countertorque with two tools; the cotter task uses insertion followed by plastic bending from opposite sides.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a locked angle retained through motion; the cotter task requires seating, two bends of at least 45°, release, and no excessive rebending.
comparison.reason: Both secure hardware, but plastic deformation after pin insertion is a different tested ability from holding a threaded adjustment against locknut torque.
